page: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-2 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the e2 server family. It features 2 vCPUs and 8.0 GB of RAM, running on an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon processor. The hardware configuration includes 1 physical core with 2 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 2.2 GHz. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and it provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the lower tiers of compute and memory capabilities. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1103.39, while the multi-core CPU score is 1451.58, placing it in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block speed of 79.92 GB/sec and a write large block speed of 10.27 GB/sec. Static web serving throughput is recorded at 1.45 GB/sec, and database operations score 826.31 on Passmark, reflecting its entry-level performance profile.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the e2-standard-2 offers a resource-dense option for workloads that do not require high-performance compute or massive memory bandwidth. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio provides a balanced allocation for lightweight applications. Given its lower benchmark scores, it is best suited for basic web serving, small-scale database operations, lightweight background tasks, and development or testing environments where high throughput is not critical.
